items.title_zh: 安全担忧升温，美国卫生与公众服务部着手收紧食品成分监管
items.summary: HHS moves to tighten oversight of food ingredients and define ultra-processed foods as food safety concerns raise questions about FDA visibility.
items.summary_zh: 在食品安全担忧引发外界质疑 FDA 监管透明度之际，美国卫生与公众服务部着手收紧食品成分监管并界定超加工食品。

items.title: Taylor Farms recalls salsa, guacamole on salmonella outbreak, intensifying food-safety fears
items.title_zh: 沙门氏菌疫情导致 Taylor Farms 召回莎莎酱和牛油果酱，加剧食品安全担忧
items.summary: Taylor Farms said on Sunday it was recalling prepared food items containing jalapenos from retailers, including Walmart, Kroger and Whole Foods in some states.
items.summary_zh: Taylor Farms 周日表示，正从部分州的零售商处召回含墨西哥辣椒的预制食品，涉及沃尔玛、克罗格和全食超市。

items.title: The yen's slide deepens, with half the gains from the historic US-Japan intervention now wiped out
items.title_zh: 日元颓势加深 美日历史性干预带来的半数涨幅已消失殆尽
items.summary: The yen fell as much as 0.8% against the dollar to 159.06, the worst performer in the Group of Ten, having given back half the gains sparked by the historic joint intervention by the United States and Japan
items.summary_zh: 日元兑美元一度下跌0.8%，至159.06，在十国集团中表现垫底，美国和日本历史性联手干预激发的涨幅已半数回吐

items.title: Zhipu's API user count approaches 7 million, with more than 50,000 domestic compute chips newly brought online
items.title_zh: 智谱API用户数近700万，新启用超5万块国产算力芯片
items.summary: Registered users of Zhipu's MaaS open platform (that is, API users) approach 7 million, up about 2 million from the start of July, including 23,000 enterprise customers; ZCode, its developer product benchmarked against Codex, passed one million users within one month of launch
items.summary_zh: 智谱 MaaS 开放平台注册用户（即 API 用户）近 700 万，相比七月初增长约 200 万，其中包括 2.3 万家企业客户，对标 Codex 的开发者产品 ZCode 上线 1 个月用户突破百万

items.title: Intel plans $15 billion stock offering as AI demand accelerates
items.title_zh: 人工智能需求加速，英特尔计划进行 150 亿美元的股票增发
items.summary: Technology giants have shelled out trillions to support insatiable AI demand and the infrastructure buildout.
items.summary_zh: 科技巨头已投入数万亿美元，以支撑贪得无厌的人工智能需求和基础设施建设。

items.title: Report: Zhipu's API user count approaches 7 million, with more than 50,000 domestic compute chips newly brought online
items.title_zh: 报道：智谱API用户数近700万，新启用超5万块国产算力芯片
items.summary: Registered users of Zhipu's MaaS open platform (that is, API users) approach 7 million, up about 2 million from the start of July, including 23,000 enterprise customers; ZCode, its developer product benchmarked against Codex, passed one million users within one month of launch
items.summary_zh: 智谱MaaS开放平台注册用户（即API用户）近700万，相比七月初增长约200万，其中包括2.3万家企业客户，对标Codex的开发者产品ZCode上线1个月用户突破百万

items.title: Archer shares surge after Boeing stake, electric aircraft subsidiary deal
items.title_zh: 波音入股并达成电动飞机子公司交易后，Archer 股价大涨
items.summary: Boeing is selling three of its subsidiaries to Archer Aviation in exchange for a stake in the eVTOL startup.
items.summary_zh: 波音将把旗下三家子公司出售给 Archer Aviation，以换取这家电动垂直起降初创公司的股份。

items.title: House Dems call for AI companies to testify on recent hacks: ‘Clear risk to safety’
items.title_zh: 众议院民主党人要求人工智能公司就近期黑客事件作证：「对安全构成明确风险」
items.summary: A group of House Democrats is calling on leaders of Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI companies to testify in Congress about recent hacking incidents.
items.summary_zh: 一批众议院民主党人正呼吁 Anthropic、OpenAI 等人工智能公司的负责人就近期黑客事件在国会作证。
